data_cdn_meta.name: tools/heal-tools.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Anthropic tool definitions for tool-use heal LLM (spec 60.2). Five tools: query_dom, dispatch_event, wait_for, take_snapshot, read_attribute. Plugin's llm-healer-v60.ts passes the `tools[]` array directly to the SDK. Per-cycle budget: 30 tool calls / 60s wall / 2 MB combined result body.

tools.name: query_dom
tools.description: Find DOM elements matching a CSS selector. Returns up to N matches with tag, classes, key attributes, computed visibility, visible size, and trimmed text. Use this to verify a selector exists and is reachable BEFORE proposing it as a patch. Issues opaque `uid` handles you reference in subsequent dispatch_event / read_attribute calls.

selector.description: CSS selector. Playwright text selectors (text=, :has-text) supported. Avoid :nth-child indices unless absolutely necessary.

scope.description: Optional scoping selector. When set, the query runs inside the first match of this selector. Use to narrow into a dialog, panel, or row.

limit.description: Max matches to return. Default 10, max 25.

tools.name: dispatch_event
tools.description: Dispatch a DOM event on a previously-queried element (referenced by uid from query_dom or take_snapshot). Returns success + dom_mutated_within_500ms summary so you can tell whether the event had any visible effect. Real-event dispatch through the plugin's primitives layer (NOT synthetic JS clicks) — what you see is what the runner would see.

uid.description: Element handle from query_dom or take_snapshot.

event.description: Event to dispatch. press_key needs a key arg. input needs a value arg.

args.description: Event-specific args. press_key: { key: 'Enter' }. input: { value: 'foo' }.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for a DOM condition. Polls every 100ms up to timeout_ms. Use when you've dispatched an event and need the page to settle before observing the result. Returns matched: bool plus elapsed_ms (NOT an error block on timeout — use matched: false in your reasoning).

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description: Capture compacted DOM at the current moment. Use SPARINGLY: snapshots are large (capped at 200 KB) and the initial heal context already includes one. Best use case: 'I clicked something, now I need to see the new dialog that appeared'. Returns dom_compact + a uid_index mapping uids to selectors so you can reference any element from the snapshot in a follow-up dispatch_event.

scope.description: Optional scoping selector. Snapshot is rooted at the first match. Default: active dialog if visible, else body.

include_invisible.description: Include off-screen / display:none elements. Default false.

tools.name: read_attribute
tools.description: Read one attribute or computed style of an element. Useful for checking aria-disabled, aria-pressed, value, computed display, etc. without a full re-query. Cheaper than query_dom (soft cost 0.5 calls). Returns null if attribute is absent (vs empty string for present-but-empty).
